title: ompTest - Unit Testing with OMPT
problem: OpenMP runtime implementations must correctly report OpenMP Tool Interface (OMPT) events, but developers lack a simple, integrated testing framework that verifies both regular functionality and OMPT event correctness. Existing OMPT tests are verbose and have poor semantic alignment with the code being tested.
motivation: Correct OMPT event reporting is critical for third-party tools that monitor, debug, and validate OpenMP programs, including GPU-accelerated applications in HPC.
method: The framework provides a simple API to write unit tests that specify expected OMPT events alongside regular test assertions. It reduces boilerplate by bridging the semantic gap between the unit under test and OMPT event verification. Tests are compiled and executed more efficiently than existing approaches. The framework was validated on the ROCm OpenMP compiler.
key_novelty: A unified testing framework that seamlessly integrates OMPT event assertions into standard unit tests, enabling more concise and readable verification of OpenMP runtime behavior.
contributions: Simple-to-use testing framework for verifying OMPT event correctness in OpenMP implementations
Improved test readability and reduced boilerplate through semantic alignment with code under test
2.5× speedup in compile and runtime performance for ROCm OMPT test suite
Coverage comparable to existing tests with better maintainability

metrics.other: Coverage similar to existing tests, improved readability

limitations: Paper does not discuss specific limitations of the approach.
